subject: Burnout 3
author: Segaswirl
body:
Yeah there is a few of us that have been playing it pretty much everyday aswell as a fair amount of new players. It's not exactly a revival or anything but it's still worth picking up if you don't have it. The online racing is unmatched in any other Burnout game in my opinion... especially if you're in a room full of players with equal or better skill. The races aren't artifically close like those in revenge. If you've earned a good lead on someone it wont wither away to 250ft through no fault of your own.

It also doesn't give you all the cars on a silver platter... so you would need to do the single player to unlock the better cars to use online.
